weapon.d:
Unit attacks twice (even if foe initiates combat, unit attacks twice).
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, unit deals +15 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 10 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and also, when unit deals damage to foe during combat, restores 7 HP to unit.

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Def.

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+6 during combat.

b.d: If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = difference between stats × 2 (max 20%). If unit initiates combat, unit moves 1 space away after combat.
